title: Strict-Saddle Landscapes and Multi-Rank Geometry in Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.37865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the optimization landscape of low-tubal-rank tensor sensing through a balanced factorization. Under a tubal restricted isometry condition, we establish a quantitative strict-saddle landscape with no spurious local minima for arbitrary Fourier multi-rank profiles. We further show that the local geometry depends on the Fourier-slice ranks rather than the tubal rank alone. Uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, whereas nonuniform ranks produce quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization, even when the factor width equals the exact tubal rank. Numerical experiments illustrate the global optimization behavior and the contrasting local geometries.

translated_title: 低管秩张量感知中的严格鞍点景观与多秩几何
translated_abstract: 我们通过平衡因式分解研究了低管秩张量感知的优化景观。在管受限等距条件下，我们对任意的傅里叶多秩轮廓建立了定量的严格鞍点景观，且不存在伪局部极小值。我们进一步表明，局部几何取决于傅里叶切片秩，而不仅仅取决于管秩：当秩均匀时，解轨道的横截方向上呈现二次增长；而当秩不均匀时，即使因子宽度恰好等于精确的管秩，隐藏的频率级过参数化也会产生四次平坦的方向。数值实验展示了全局优化行为以及截然不同的局部几何。
tldr: 本文证明了低管秩张量感知在管受限等距条件下具有无伪局部极小值的严格鞍点优化景观，并揭示局部几何由傅里叶切片秩而非管秩决定——秩均匀时解轨道横向呈二次增长，秩不均匀时因隐藏的频率级过参数化而出现四次平坦方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that low-tubal-rank tensor sensing admits a quantitative strict-saddle optimization landscape with no spurious local minima under a tubal restricted isometry condition, and reveals that the local geometry is governed by Fourier-slice ranks rather than tubal rank alone: uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, while nonuniform ranks create quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization.
